$comment: Smoke contract for the MAUI.Sherpa consumer head.
Sherpa is validated as a SEPARATE CONSUMER, not as part of this repository. Nothing in
Sherpa changes here. This file is the handoff: it states exactly which packages Sherpa
consumes, from which feed, and what 'working' means, so the Sherpa side can implement the
head against a fixed contract instead of against a moving target.
Validated for well-formedness by Maui.Tizen.Consumer.Tests. Executed by the Sherpa
repository's own pipeline once a package feed exists; see docs/validation/sherpa.md.

consumer.name: MAUI.Sherpa
consumer.role: External consumer head. Exercises Maui.Tizen packages the way a real application does, which is the only way to catch packaging and MSBuild problems that a source build cannot see.

$comment: The feed is supplied to the Sherpa pipeline as a parameter, never committed here.
No credentials, URLs to private infrastructure, or account identifiers belong in this file.
packageFeed.fallback: When unset, the Sherpa smoke job reports 'not run' rather than failing, because no feed exists until the Samsung workload unblocks packing.

smokeSteps.description: Restore the Sherpa Tizen head against the supplied feed.
smokeSteps.failureMeaning: Package metadata or dependency graph is wrong; this is a packaging defect, not a Sherpa defect.

smokeSteps.description: Assert the restored graph violates none of the banned resolutions in eng/validation/profiles/tizen-profiles.json.
smokeSteps.failureMeaning: A banned transitive dependency reached a real consumer. Most likely Tizen.UIExtensions pulling MAUI Graphics 6.x.

smokeSteps.description: Build the Sherpa Tizen head for the primary target framework.
smokeSteps.failureMeaning: buildTransitive targets or assembly references are broken for consumers.
Packaging or tizen-manifest.xml generation is broken.

smokeSteps.description: Install and launch on an emulator or device, and confirm the first page renders.
smokeSteps.failureMeaning: The app builds but does not run: typically a missing runtime dependency that only appears in a packaged app.

reportsBackTo.mechanism: commit status on the Maui.Tizen commit that produced the packages
